- If the Thunder lose tonight, do they have any shot to come back?
- Jason Kidd OUT as Mavs head coach...Was this the right move?

- NBA Conference Finals

- Giants Head Coach pledges to beat the Cowboys…is it too early for this? 

🤳🏾: 888-623-3646 
🎧: sxm.app.link/MadDogRadio

Unfiltered! No-holds-barred! I am coming in HOT on @MadDogRadio! 

DOUBLE OT. Wemby goes for 41. Spurs take Game 1! What are your thoughts about the game?

But let’s talk about it…You know the number to call! 

🎙️: sxm.app.link/MadDogRadio
 ☎️ : 888-623-3646

Video

Listening to @RealMikeWilbon on @GetUpESPN just now talking about the @nyknicks vs @cavs as a junior varsity game compared to what we witnessed last night with @okcthunder vs @spurs…😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡😡.

This man @wemby! Good Lord have mercy! The league is HIS. Unreal performance. Not so much for @shaiglalex on his MVP-Award night, and certainly not for @ChetHolmgren. It’s only Game 1,  but what a statement, a message, by @wemby and the @spurs.  Game 2 will determine if we even have a series, if @Wemby is gonna look like this!

I hope you got everything off your chest Jaylen Brown! 

🤳🏾: ON YOUTUBE NOW: piped.video/Tcoee2hwX8c?si=Z5YK…

Video

Make no mistake, the LINES ARE OPEN until 3PM on @MadDogRadio ! 

Aaron Rodgers is back in Pittsburgh on a 1-year deal! As a Steelers fan, Does this make you any more hopeful for the season with Mike McCarthy at the helm? 

I want to hear from you! 

☎️: 888-623-3646
🎧: sxm.app.link/SASonSXM

Ladies and gentlemen..it is the TOP of the week and I am coming in HOT on @MadDogRadio! 

You don't have to agree with me...but don't sit on your best SPORT TAKES!

* Cavs BLOWING OUT #1 seeded Pistons in GAME 7...
* SGA wins Back-To-Back MVP awards...
* Should Yankee fans be worried about their recent stretch?

🎧: sxm.app.link/MadDogRadio

Congrats to @shaiglalex for winning back-to-back MVP’s. He got my vote both times and he deserved it. @wemby is phenomenal. Jokic, @FCHWPO and @lukadoncic all had great years, but it was @shaiglalex who led him team to the best record in the league and the No.1 seed. The @okcthunder haven’t missed a beat. Why? Because he was leading, that’s why! Congrats!!!

Does Iran profit more?
Jalen Brunson, PUT ON A SHOW!!  NEW YOUTUBE OUT NOW!!
Dave Rubin and I talk about it all!  Be sure to SUBSCRIBE to my YouTube to be one of the first to hear the full interview!
F*ck ME??!!!…why all the venom!  ON YOUTUBE NOW 🔗 in BIO!
I’m going to give the Braves some love! Great having you on the show T.I.!
We have to stay focused!!  #politics #straightshooter #voting
I don’t know …Does it make any sense to even ask who the defensive player of the year is going to be for years to come?
Can you imagine that?! Tune into my YOUTUBE EPISODE TODAY…I think he has 5 choices for his future.
Let’s see what happens tonight!
We just don’t agree on this one…Skip Bayless!  Watch the FULL EPISODE ON YOUTUBE NOW!
Ladies are you being 100% transparent!  Full Episode on YouTube!!
